description: A two-factor authentication screen with a six-digit code entry, error feedback, and a resend countdown.
overview: A two-factor screen with a six-digit code field that turns red on a wrong code and green on success, plus a resend countdown and a help link. A wrong code shakes the field and clears it. Use it for 2FA, phone verification or any one-time code step.
usage: Replace the comparison with `DEMO_CODE` in `complete` with your verification API, and remove the demo code hint. Resend only restarts the 30-second timer, so connect it to your code delivery service. Point `#help` at your support page.
notes: The code field receives focus on load, and errors are announced.
